title: "phenotyping"
author: "Xiaomin"
format: html
editor: visual
---

This document details the process of cleaning, preparing, and analyzing humoral data related to HBV vaccination. The analysis involves several steps, including data import, merging of different batches, handling of duplicates, and integration of metadata. The primary goal is to explore the antibody responses over time, particularly in different age groups and vaccine types.

# --- Load Data and processing for merge---

```{r}
phenoflow<-read_excel("./data/20260320Pheno_cleandata_table_xy.xls")
phenoflow <- phenoflow |>
  mutate(make.unique = paste(Participant, Visit, sep = "_"))
elisaMeta<-read_csv("./outs/elisa_mergeMeta.csv")

```

#-----merge pheno with elisaMeta-----

```{r}
phenoflow_elisa_Meta <- full_join(
  phenoflow,
  elisaMeta,
  by = "make.unique",
  suffix = c(".pheno", ".elisa")
) 
  
# 1) Build a clean metadata table from elisaMeta
meta_clean <- elisaMeta %>%
  group_by(Participant) %>%        # or Participant.pheno if that's the name there
  summarise(
    FirstVisit        = first(na.omit(FirstVisit)),
    Age               = first(na.omit(Age)),
    Sex               = first(na.omit(Sex)),
    Race              = first(na.omit(Race)),
    Ethnicity         = first(na.omit(Ethnicity)),
    BMI               = first(na.omit(BMI)),
    StatusAtEnrollment = first(na.omit(StatusAtEnrollment)),
    Product           = first(na.omit(Product)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2) Join this back to the stitched data
phenoflow_elisa_Meta <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  left_join(meta_clean,
            by = c("Participant.pheno" = "Participant"),
            suffix = c("", ".meta"))

# 3) Fill NAs in stitched columns from the meta_clean columns
phenoflow_elisa_Meta <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  mutate(
    FirstVisit        = coalesce(FirstVisit,        FirstVisit.meta),
    Age               = coalesce(Age,               Age.meta),
    Sex               = coalesce(Sex,               Sex.meta),
    Race              = coalesce(Race,              Race.meta),
    Ethnicity         = coalesce(Ethnicity,         Ethnicity.meta),
    BMI               = coalesce(BMI,               BMI.meta),
    StatusAtEnrollment = coalesce(StatusAtEnrollment, StatusAtEnrollment.meta),
    Product           = coalesce(Product,           Product.meta)
  ) %>%
  select(
    -ends_with(".meta")   # remove helper columns
  )
#remove space in column names
names(phenoflow_elisa_Meta) <- gsub(" ", ".", names(phenoflow_elisa_Meta))

#define final elisa for every participant
phenoflow_elisa_Meta <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  group_by(Participant.elisa) %>%
  arrange(Visit.elisa, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Elisa.final = {
      # last non-NA elisa.HBsAb in this participant
      vals <- elisa.HBsAb
      vals[rev(seq_along(vals))[which(!is.na(rev(vals)))[1]]]
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
#define memoryTtets and Activate.cTfh %in CD4
phenoflow_elisa_Meta <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  mutate(
    memDRB01 = `DRB0101+`*DRB01_nonnaive/100,
    memDRB07 = `DRB0701+`*DRB07_nonnaive/100,
    Activated.cTfh.CD4 = Activated.cTfh*cTfh/100,
    CD8.GZMB = `CD8.GZMB+...39`+ `CD8.GZMB+...40`
  ) 

```

#-----T-Tets plots timecourse, DRB0701### naive group all DRB0701-----

```{r}
###naive group all DRB0701
# 1) Filter data
df_plot <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  filter(
    Tets %in% c("DRB07_=HLA","DRB07_?HLA","DRB07_≠HLA"),
    StatusAtEnrollment == "HBVnaive"
  )

# 2) Labels for last visit per participant
df_labels <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(Participant.pheno) %>%
  filter(Visit.pheno == max(Visit.pheno)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3) Average per visit
df_avg <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(Visit.pheno) %>%
  summarise(
    DRB0701_mean = mean(`DRB0701+`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 4) Compute p-values for each visit vs v1w0
#    Assumes Visit.pheno is something like "v1w0", "v1w4", etc.
baseline_visit <- "v1w0"

# paired t-test per visit vs baseline (by Participant.pheno)
df_pvals <- df_plot %>%
  filter(Visit.pheno %in% c(baseline_visit)) %>%
  select(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno, DRB0701_base = `DRB0701+`) %>%
  right_join(
    df_plot %>% select(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno, DRB0701 = `DRB0701+`),
    by = "Participant.pheno"
  ) %>%
  filter(Visit.pheno.y != baseline_visit) %>%   # keep non-baseline visits
  group_by(Visit.pheno.y) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = {
      # match baseline and current visit within participant
      x <- DRB0701_base[!is.na(DRB0701_base) & !is.na(DRB0701)]
      y <- DRB0701[!is.na(DRB0701_base) & !is.na(DRB0701)]
      if (length(x) > 1) {
        t.test(y, x, paired = TRUE)$p.value
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Visit.pheno = Visit.pheno.y)

# 5) Prepare text positions for p-values (slightly above mean line)
df_ptext <- df_avg %>%
  left_join(df_pvals, by = "Visit.pheno") %>%
  mutate(
    label = ifelse(is.na(p_value),
                   NA_character_,
                   paste0("p = ", signif(p_value, 3))),
    y_pos = DRB0701_mean + 0.4 * diff(range(DRB0701_mean, na.rm = TRUE)) # adjust offset
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(label))  # keep only rows that will be labeled

# 6) Plot
pnaive <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = `DRB0701+`)) +
  geom_point(color = "lightgray") +
  geom_line(aes(group = Participant.pheno), alpha = 0.5, color= "lightgray") +
  geom_line(
    data = df_avg,
    aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = DRB0701_mean, group = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "red",
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = df_avg,
    aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = DRB0701_mean),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "red",
    size = 5
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = df_labels,
    aes(label = Participant.pheno, x = Visit.pheno, y = `DRB0701+`),
    size = 2,
    color = "lightgray",
    max.overlaps = Inf,        # let ggrepel consider all labels
  box.padding = 0.4,         # more padding around labels
  point.padding = 0.3,
  min.segment.length = 0,    # always draw segments
  force = 1.5               # increase repulsion
  ) +
  # add p-values as text above the mean line
  geom_text(
    data = df_ptext,
    aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = y_pos, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "red",
    fontface = "bold.italic",
    vjust = 0,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Visit",
    y = "DRB0701+ (% of CD4 T cells)",
    title = "DRB0701 over visits"
  ) +
  ct2 

#####--------------------------------------------------------------------

######################################################DRB0701+ memory phenotype over time(naive)
df_long <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  select(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno, DRB07_naive, DRB07_nonnaive,
         StatusAtEnrollment, Tets) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("DRB07_naive", "DRB07_nonnaive"),
    names_to = "Subtype",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Subtype = factor(
      Subtype,
      levels = c("DRB07_naive", "DRB07_nonnaive"),
      labels = c("Naive", "Non-naive")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Visit.pheno != "NA",
    Tets %in% c("DRB07_=HLA","DRB07_?HLA","DRB07_≠HLA"),
    StatusAtEnrollment == "HBVnaive"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno) %>%
  # keep only participant-visit pairs where Naive + Non-naive > 0
  filter(sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  ungroup()

# Aggregate and convert to percentages per visit
df_pct <- df_long %>%
  group_by(Visit.pheno, Subtype) %>%
  summarise(Value = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Percent = 100 * Value / Total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(df_pct, aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = Percent, fill = Subtype)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  labs(
    x = "Visit",
    y = " % of DRB0701+",
    fill = "Subtype",
   
    title = "DRB0701 memory phenotype over visits"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
 ct2

# 4) Compute p-values for each visit vs v1w0
```

```{r}
      y <- DRB0101[!is.na(DRB0101_base) & !is.na(DRB0101)]

# 5) Prepare text positions for p-values (slightly above mean line)

df_long <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  select(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno, DRB01_naive, DRB01_nonnaive,
         StatusAtEnrollment, Tets) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("DRB01_naive", "DRB01_nonnaive"),
    names_to = "Subtype",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Subtype = factor(
      Subtype,
      levels = c("DRB01_naive", "DRB01_nonnaive"),
      labels = c("Naive", "Non-naive")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Visit.pheno != "NA",
    Tets %in% c("DRB01_=HLA","DRB01_?HLA","DRB01_≠HLA"),
    StatusAtEnrollment == "HBVnaive"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno) %>%
  # keep only participant-visit pairs where Naive + Non-naive > 0
  filter(sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  ungroup()

# Aggregate and convert to percentages per visit
df_pct <- df_long %>%
  group_by(Visit.pheno, Subtype) %>%
  summarise(Value = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Percent = 100 * Value / Total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

  labs(
    x = "Visit",
    y = " % of DRB0101+",
    fill = "Subtype",
   
    title = "DRB0101 memory phenotype over visits"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
```

#-----T-Tets plots Ab correlation-----

```{r}
df <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta
make_cor_plot <- function(
  df,
  tets_values,
  drb_col,
  visit_pheno,
  visit_elisa,
  x_label,
  y_label,
  title
) {
  # phenotype at specified Visit.pheno
  pheno <- df %>%
    filter(
      Tets %in% tets_values,
      Visit.pheno == visit_pheno
    ) %>%
    select(Participant.pheno, DRB = all_of(drb_col))
  
  # ELISA at specified Visit.elisa
  elisa <- df %>%
    filter(Visit.elisa == visit_elisa) %>%
    select(Participant.elisa, elisa = elisa.HBsAb)
  
  # join by participant
  dat <- pheno %>%
    inner_join(elisa, by = c("Participant.pheno" = "Participant.elisa"))
  
  # compute Pearson correlation (change to "spearman" if desired)
  ct <- cor.test(dat$DRB, dat$elisa, use = "complete.obs", method = "pearson")
  r_val <- unname(ct$estimate)
  p_val <- ct$p.value
  
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = DRB, y = elisa)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
    labs(
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label,
      title = title,
      subtitle = paste0("r = ", round(r_val, 2), 
                        ", p = ", signif(p_val, 3))
    ) +
    theme_bw()
}

p_DRB01_v2 <- make_cor_plot(
  df = df,
  tets_values = c("DRB01_=HLA","DRB01_?HLA","DRB01_≠HLA"),
  drb_col = "memDRB01",
  visit_pheno = "v2w1",
  visit_elisa = "v2w4",
  x_label = "memDRB01 at v2w1 ((% of CD4 T cells))",
  y_label = "HBsAb (ELISA) at v2w4",
  title   = "memDRB01 v2w1 vs HBsAb v2w4"
)
```

#-----------iterations of different flowmarkers over visit plot function----------------------

```{r}

plot_marker_over_visits <- function(df,
                                    marker,
                                    status_group = c("HBVnaive", "HBVimmune"),
                                    baseline_visit = "v1w0",
                                    labels_df = NULL,
                                    y_label = NULL,
                                    plot_title = NULL,
                                    x_limits = NULL) {

  status_group <- match.arg(status_group)

  marker_sym  <- ensym(marker)
  marker_syml <- sym(paste0(as_string(marker_sym), " (% of parent)"))

  # 1) Filter data
  df_plot <- df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Visit.pheno),
      StatusAtEnrollment == status_group
    )

  # 2) Average per visit
  df_avg <- df_plot %>%
    group_by(Visit.pheno) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_val = mean(!!marker_sym, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # 3) Paired t-test vs baseline
  df_pvals <- df_plot %>%
  filter(Visit.pheno %in% c(baseline_visit)) %>%
  select(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno, base = !!marker_sym) %>%
  right_join(
    df_plot %>% select(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno, value = !!marker_sym),
    by = "Participant.pheno"
  ) %>%
  filter(Visit.pheno.y != baseline_visit) %>%   # keep non-baseline visits
  group_by(Visit.pheno.y) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = {
      # match baseline and current visit within participant
        x <- base[!is.na(base) & !is.na(value)]
        y <- value[!is.na(base) & !is.na(value)]
      if (length(x) > 1) {
        t.test(y, x, paired = TRUE)$p.value
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Visit.pheno = Visit.pheno.y)

  # 4) P‑value label positions
  df_ptext <- df_avg %>%
    left_join(df_pvals, by = "Visit.pheno") %>%
    mutate(
      label = ifelse(
        is.na(p_value),
        NA_character_,
        paste0("p = ", signif(p_value, 3))
      ),
      y_pos = mean_val + 1 * diff(range(mean_val, na.rm = TRUE))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(label))

  # Default labels if not provided
  if (is.null(y_label)) {
    y_label <- rlang::as_name(marker_syml)
  }
  if (is.null(plot_title)) {
    plot_title <- paste0(rlang::as_name(marker_sym), " over visits (", status_group, ")")
  }

  # Labels df
  if (!is.null(labels_df)) {
    labels_df <- labels_df %>%
      mutate(value = !!marker_sym)
  } else {
    labels_df <- df_plot %>%
      mutate(value = !!marker_sym)
  }

  # 5) Plot
 p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = !!marker_sym)) +
  geom_point(color = "lightgray") +
  geom_line(aes(group = Participant.pheno), alpha = 0.5, color= "lightgray") +
  geom_line(
    data = df_avg,
    aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = mean_val, group = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "red",
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = df_avg,
    aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = mean_val),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "red",
    size = 5
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = df_labels,
    aes(label = Participant.pheno, x = Visit.pheno, y = !!marker_sym),
    size = 2,
    color = "lightgray",
    max.overlaps = Inf,        # let ggrepel consider all labels
  box.padding = 0.4,         # more padding around labels
  point.padding = 0.3,
  min.segment.length = 0,    # always draw segments
  force = 1.5               # increase repulsion
  ) +
  # add p-values as text above the mean line
   geom_text(
    data = df_ptext,
    aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = y_pos, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "red",
    fontface = "bold.italic",
    vjust = 0,
    size = 3
  ) +
 labs(
    x = "Visit",
    y = y_label,
    title = plot_title
  ) +
  ct2 
 print(p)
  }



```


```{r}

markers <- colnames(phenoflow_elisa_Meta)
markers <- markers[-c(1:3, 17:30, 32, 33, 39, 40, 41:81)]
plots_naive <- lapply(
  markers,
  \(m) plot_marker_over_visits(
    df = phenoflow_elisa_Meta,
    marker = !!sym(m),       # Add the bang-bang operator here
    status_group = "HBVnaive",
    baseline_visit = "v1w0"
  )
)
# 1. Define the layout (3 columns x 7 rows = 21 plots per page)
# 'grobs' is your list of plots
# 'nrow' and 'ncol' define the grid
# 'top' can be a dynamic title or NULL
multi_page_plot <- marrangeGrob(
  grobs = plots_naive, 
  nrow = 6, 
  ncol = 2, 
  top = "HBV Naive Marker Analysis"
)

# 2. Export to PDF
# Adjust width and height for a standard A4 or Letter feel (e.g., 8.5 x 11 or 12 x 18)
ggsave(
  filename = "./figs/Flow_pheno_HBVnaive_Markers_Grid.pdf", 
  plot = multi_page_plot, 
  width = 12, 
  height = 18
)
```
